topics.headline: Oil shock threatens August CPI/HICP rebound after June declines
topics.summary: Both US CPI (3.5%) and Eurozone HICP (2.8%) fell in June, but a collapsed ceasefire has sent Brent from under $70 to above $85, raising real risk that July/August prints reverse course; still, most economists expect disinflation to persist unless oil sustains near $100.

topics.headline: HY spreads near cycle lows, but asymmetry tilts toward widening
topics.summary: At ~2.69-2.74%, HY OAS sits near historic tights with little room to compress further, and while cooler CPI and contained volatility argue for near-term stability, structural asymmetry (State Street, LPL) suggests modest widening is more likely than further tightening over 30 days.

topics.headline: Bitcoin ETF inflows rebound, but fragile after record outflow streak
topics.summary: After an $9.46B eight-week outflow streak, spot Bitcoin ETFs saw three straight positive days (July 14-16) totaling over $360M, led by BlackRock's IBIT, but analysts like Thielen warn it's too early to call a trend reversal given seasonal patterns and YTD outflows still at $5.8B ahead of the July 28-29 Fed meeting.

topics.headline: VIX at 15.67, below elevated 3-month average, Hormuz risk lingers
topics.summary: After a spike to 17.40 on July 13 tied to Brent's 9.6% oil rally, VIX fell 5% to 15.67 on July 15—still below its recent 3-month average (April alone averaged 19.31)—as traders weigh a fragile Iran ceasefire and Strait of Hormuz shipping still at just 34% of normal capacity.

topics.headline: Deal pace stays near-weekly; Chevron-Microsoft 2.67GW PPA just signed
topics.summary: Base rates strongly favor resolution YES: Chevron's subsidiary just signed a 20-year, 2.67GW dedicated PPA with Microsoft in West Texas, continuing a pattern where every major hyperscaler has already inked at least one nuclear/power deal this year (13+ projects, 9.8GW+) amid tripling US data-center power demand forecasts.
